Behind him, a mid-tempo electronic synthesizer beat plays alongside the digital sounds of a video game interface, including selection clicks and movement swooshes. (2) A sudden shift occurs when the speaker vocalizes surprise, followed immediately by a comedic 'huh' sound effect and a momentary pause in the background music. The vocal intensity remains high but pivots toward humor and mock confusion. (3) The narrator's speech pattern becomes more rhythmic, almost mimicking a play-by-play announcer. The BGM resumes with a steady 4/4 drum machine pattern. Audible impact sounds from the game, such as character strikes and gold collection dings, are mixed prominently. (4) The final phase features a change in vocal texture as the narrator uses a megaphone; the audio becomes intentionally distorted and mid-heavy, sounding like a public address system. His volume increases to a shout, ending with a bright, triumphant musical flourish.
